title: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 188
summary: Comparison is carried here from gauree, Fifth Mehla: toward says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels envious, unsettled, small, because it keeps comparison inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Comparison steadies when says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect.

lines.translation: Perfect is the path; perfect is the cleansing bath.
Everything is perfect, if the Naam is in the heart. ||1||
One's honor remains perfect, when the Perfect Lord preserves it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: His servant takes to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Perfect is the peace; perfect is the contentment.
Perfect is the penance; perfect is the Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||
On the Lord's Path, sinners are purified.
Perfect is their glory; perfect is their humanity. ||3||
They dwell forever in the Presence of the Creator Lord.
Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect. ||4||45||114||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: gauree, Fifth Mehla:.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside perfect is the peace; perfect is the contentment.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect.
